cd /workspace && cat > tmp/t4.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, subprocess, sys

DIR={"sip:ember@studio.test":["sip:e1@alias.studio.test"]}
ACC={"s":{"primary":"sip:ember@studio.test","allow":[]}}
GW={"edge":{"local_domains":["studio.test"],"peers":{}}}
LOC={"kind":"local","subject":"s"}

def mkraw(pad):
    body="x"*pad
    head=("MESSAGE sip:relay.test SIP/2.0\r\n"
          "f: <sip:ember@studio.test>\r\n"
          "t: <sip:relay.test>\r\n"
          "i: cid\r\n"
          "CSeq: 1 MESSAGE\r\n"
          "l: %d\r\n\r\n"%len(body))
    return head+body

# find a raw whose length is exactly 32768
raw = mkraw(32768 - len(mkraw(0)))
assert len(raw)==32768, len(raw)
jobs=[{"gateway":"edge","ingress":LOC,"trusted_out":True,"raw":raw},
      {"gateway":"edge","ingress":LOC,"trusted_out":True,"source":0},
      {"gateway":"edge","ingress":LOC,"trusted_out":True,"raw":raw+"y"},
      {"gateway":"edge","ingress":LOC,"trusted_out":True,"source":2}]
batch={"directory":DIR,"accounts":ACC,"gateways":GW,"jobs":jobs}
out=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/workspace/submission/gateway.py"],input=json.dumps(batch).encode(),capture_output=True)
res=json.loads(out.stdout)["results"]
for i,r in enumerate(res):
    print(i, r.get("status"), r.get("reason",""), "wirelen=", len(r.get("wire","")))
PYEOF
python3 tmp/t4.py
